argument:
The bull establishes a high-quality growing business, but that is different from establishing an attractive current purchase. Quarterly FCF fell to $18.633 billion from $25.663 billion as capex increased, and gross margin slipped. Returns on the growing investment commitment remain unproved; same-basis valuation is unavailable.

Price being above SMA200 does not resolve timing: it has lost SMA20 and SMA50, fallen 5.05% over five bars and retains negative MACD. AI launches are prospective catalysts, not delivered incremental profit. Waiting for stabilization would require less reliance on an assumed recovery.
key_points: Growth accompanied by weaker cash conversion
No demonstrated valuation margin of safety
rebuttal_to_previous: The durable-business argument is conceded, but modest measured leverage and an intact long average do not neutralize deteriorating short-term momentum or establish investment returns.
